# vibeoncall_team (Data Source)

Looks up a team by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vibeoncall_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name. Matched exactly.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Team description.
- `id` (String) Numeric team ID, referenced as `team_id` by other resources.
- `short_id` (String) Team short ID, e.g. `VP-TEAM-…`.
